title: Uncle Matt: missiles disabled at Malmstrom all the time

tellings.quote: happens all the time. These things would happen and disable the nuclear weapons.

plain: At Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, which held nuclear missiles, UFOs disabling the weapons is said to have happened "all the time" in the early 1970s. The physicist Kevin Knuth, a former NASA scientist, tells Michels this is what his uncle, Matt LaCroix, who served there, told him. If true, it would mean something was repeatedly switching off US nuclear weapons.
